title: mos.metadata.v1
description: Disc-identity record emitted by `mos metadata --json` (design: doc/research/2026-06-10-media-info-design.md). The `disc` object is THE FINGERPRINT SUBTREE: consumers hash its canonical serialization (or a class-appropriate subset, e.g. disc.toc alone for audio CDs; match policy is theirs). Identity fields are REQUIRED AND NULLABLE, never optional — a fixed key set keeps the canonical form trivial. null means the fact was unreadable or inapplicable at capture; partial readability is the normal regime, not an error. Hard failures (drive unopenable, state query failed) emit mos.error.v1 instead.

schema.description: Schema identifier. Per-document versioned — consumers dispatch on this field.

bsd.description: Whole-disk dev node, or null when no IOMedia child exists (media absent). Addressing/capture context, NOT part of the fingerprint subtree.

captured_at.description: Wall-clock capture time, RFC 3339 UTC with millisecond precision (same rendering as mos.probe.v0 ts). Capture context, not identity.

volume_path.description: Mount point of the disc's volume (DiskArbitration VolumePath), or null when not mounted. Unmounted is the COMMON case for UDF video discs. Mount-point bytes are environment-controlled; consumers quoting them own their own escaping.

disc.description: The fingerprint subtree. Fixed key set (additionalProperties: false + all keys required): a v1 consumer hashing the canonical serialization never sees a key this schema does not name.

profile.description: MMC current-profile code (lowercase 0xNNNN), or null when no profile was reported (drive not READY — the state core populates the profile only on READY to avoid stale-profile leakage; see mos.state.v1).

class.description: Coarse media class derived from profile by mos_profile_class(); null when profile is null or classless. Same closed set as mos.state.v1 media_class (drift-guarded in validate.py).

toc.description: READ TOC/PMA/ATIP format 0000b decode (LBA addressing), or null when the disc/drive did not answer or the reply failed the fail-closed parse (out-of-range, duplicate, or non-ascending tracks; header/descriptor mismatch — see mos_internal_toc_parse). For CDs this is THE identity primitive (MusicBrainz/CDDB ids are pure functions of these fields, computed consumer-side). A synthesized single-track DVD/BD TOC is emitted faithfully but is identity-useless — never key on it (research doc).

leadout_lba.description: Lead-out start LBA, or null when the TOC carried no lead-out descriptor — which means NO IDENTITY: do not dedup on a lead-out-less TOC. On non-CD media the whole TOC is drive-FABRICATED per spec (MMC-5 table 483 for DVD; Mt. Fuji INF-TA-1010 for BD): one data track at LBA 0 plus this lead-out. On overwritable media (DVD+RW/BD-RE) some firmwares report formatted capacity rather than written extent here — do not treat it as a precise recorded-data size; READ DISC INFORMATION is the size authority.

data.description: Q-channel control bit 2 (data track). Derived from control; carried explicitly so consumers need no bit arithmetic.

disc_info.description: READ DISC INFORMATION (0x51) decode, or null when the drive/disc did not answer (pressed DVD-ROM/BD-ROM units that reject 0x51 are normal). status 'other' is the NORMAL regime for random-access recordable media (DVD-RAM, BD-RE) — not an anomaly.

status.description: Disc status (byte 2 bits 1:0) via mos_disc_status_description() — drift-guarded in validate.py.

tracks.description: Last track number in the last session — the track count under MMC's from-1 numbering.

volume_name.description: Mounted volume's name (DiskArbitration VolumeName), or null when not mounted or unlabeled. MOUNT-SOURCED ONLY: present-but-unmounted discs read null by design — sector-derived names are the consumer's to obtain and parse (scope doctrine). Volume names are disc-controlled bytes, emitted byte-faithfully under JSON string escaping; terminal quoting is the consumer's job.

allOf.title: class is null when profile is null
allOf.description: class is a pure function of profile; a class without a profile would be fabricated data.

allOf.title: volume_name requires a mount
allOf.description: volume_name is DA-sourced and DA carries a name only for mounted volumes; a name with volume_path null would claim a source that cannot have produced it.
